answer: Every identity must first grow a timber, a VDF proof needing 6 hours of sequential compute on one core, unsplittable. Five verifiers check each proof at the daily dawn batch and publish it on-ledger for re-check. The ladder does the work. The nth identity from one wallet waits 6 hours times n, so 100 clones need 6 x 5050, or 30,300 core-hours, $15,150 at $0.50 an hour, against $300 for 100 honest agents. A forged proof turns its identity into a relic, void forever, and the verifier who blessed it loses its own timber. No forest prints overnight; each tree still grows its own rings.
